notes: Site: Shopify (nkuku.com). Discovery: mega-menu (desktop+mobile) parsed from homepage, plus /collections.json (774 handles, 4 pages) scanned for sale/clearance/outlet/archive keywords, plus site search for 'clearance' and 'outlet' (both returned generic fuzzy-matched products with no relation to clearance/outlet in title -- confirmed the search is NOT flat/default since a nonsense query correctly returned '0 results', so this is real evidence there is no dedicated Clearance/Outlet-tagged product set beyond what's below). Probed direct URL guesses /collections/{sale,clearance,outlet,final-sale,last-chance,end-of-line} -- only /collections/sale was checked and 404'd; the site's actual sale URL is /collections/all-sale. The ONLY sale/discount-adjacent nav entry is 'Sale' -> /collections/all-sale. Sale-vs-Clearance judgment (brief Section 3): the nav label is literally 'Sale', the <title> tag reads 'Sale | Up to 50% off Unique Furniture, Lighting, Furnishings and Home Accessories | Nkuku', and the on-page body copy is generic promotional language ('Save up to 50% on this curated collection of thoughtfully crafted pieces with enduring style and lasting value') with NO explicit outlet/discontinued/final-sale/end-of-line/last-chance wording anywhere on the page. However the collection's own internal H1/title is 'Up to 50% Off The Home Archive' -- 'Archive' naming is an unusual signal that could indicate permanently retired/discontinued stock rather than a temporary seasonal campaign, so this is genuinely ambiguous rather than a clean generic-Sale exclude. Recorded per the brief's ambiguity instruction rather than silently dropped or silently included. Also found and deliberately NOT included as separate rows: a family of percent-off filter collections (sale-10-percent-off ... sale-60-percent-off, accessories-sale, jewellery-sale, kitchen-dining-sale, mirrors-sale, tableware-sale, vases-planters-sale, outdoor-sale, soft-furnishings-sale, etc.) -- none of these are linked from live navigation (only found via the /collections.json dump), they are price-band/category filter cuts of the same single all-sale event, not a genuine site-exposed sub-structure like 'Furniture Clearance / Lighting Clearance'.

rows.flag: MANUAL REVIEW: AMBIGUOUS SALE/CLEARANCE - site nav label is 'Sale' and <title> tag is 'Sale | Up to 50% off...', with generic promotional body copy and no outlet/discontinued/final-sale/end-of-line wording; but the collection's own H1 is 'Up to 50% Off The Home Archive', and 'Archive' naming suggests permanently retired stock rather than a temporary campaign. Genuinely uncertain which side of the Sale/Clearance line this falls on.
